dct_description_sm: Environics Environmental Monitor (EEM) is a public opinion survey of Canadian citizens. The Environmental Monitor is a syndicated quarterly report of Canadian public attitudes toward environmental and natural resource issues. Each quarterly report is based on the results of 1,500 telephone interviews with a representative sample of adult Canadians. Currently, data are available through the Canadian Opinion Research Archive from 1987. EEM is produced by Environics Research Group Limited, Toronto, Ontario.
